title: Luxurious group retreat in the heart of Nashville
description:
Welcome to your Music City vacation headquarter located within a mile of Nashville's most sought after music, restaurant, sport, historic and entertainment venues.  Over 2500 square feet of living space to relax.  See downtown from third floor rooftop deck. Backyard bricked patio. TWO master bedrooms (kings), a queen and 2 twins - 6 beds total. Sleeps 8. Bonus room king roll out fits 2 additional people to sleep 10 if needed.

The space
We have worked closely with designers to provide luxurious and unique settings in every room.  We are confident you will walk away saying this was the best or one of the best vacation locations you have ever stayed at. We pride ourselves in giving our guests the best.

Guest access
You have access to the entire property with the exception of a few locked closets where maintenance supplies and utility equipment are located.

Other things to note
For those times you want to simply relax and talk with friends or family, enjoy the backyard brick patio.  It is enclosed by a six foot privacy fence. There are ample tables and chairs. Plus, there is a back yard porch with an overhead fan if a natural breeze is not cooperating that day.
